max_context_length.description: Maximum number of tokens to send to the model.

sampler_order.description: Sampler order to be used. If N is the length of this array, then N must be greater than or equal to 6 and the array must be a permutation of the first N non-negative integers.

sampler_seed.description: RNG seed to use for sampling. If not specified, the global RNG will be used.

stop_sequence.description: An array of string sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens. The returned text WILL contain the stop sequence if trim_stop is false.

use_default_badwordsids.description: If true, prevents the EOS token from being generated (Ban EOS).

dynatemp_range.description: If not equal to 0, uses dynamic temperature. Dynamic temperature range will be between Temp+Range and Temp-Range. If equal to 0 , uses static temperature.

smoothing_factor.description: Modifies temperature behavior. If greater than 0 uses smoothing factor.

mirostat.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. Sets the mirostat mode, 0=disabled, 1=mirostat_v1, 2=mirostat_v2

genkey.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. A unique genkey set by the user. When checking a polled-streaming request, use this key to be able to fetch pending text even if multiuser is enabled.

grammar.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. A string containing the GBNF grammar to use.

grammar_retain_state.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. If true, retains the previous generation's grammar state, otherwise it is reset on new generation.

memory.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. If set, forcefully appends this string to the beginning of any submitted prompt text. If resulting context exceeds the limit, forcefully overwrites text from the beginning of the main prompt until it can fit. Useful to guarantee full memory insertion even when you cannot determine exact token count.

images.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. If set, takes an array of base64 encoded strings, each one representing an image to be processed.

trim_stop.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. If true, also removes detected stop_sequences from the output and truncates all text after them. If false, output will also include stop sequence and potentially a few additional characters.

render_special.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. If true, prints special tokens as text for GGUF models

bypass_eos.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. If true, allows EOS token to be generated, but does not stop generation. Not recommended unless you know what you are doing.

banned_tokens.description: An array of string sequences, each entry represents a word or phrase prevented from being generated, either modifying model vocab or by backtracking and regenerating when they appear.

logit_bias.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. An dictionary of key-value pairs, which indicate the token IDs (int) and logit bias (float) to apply for that token.

dry_multiplier.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. DRY multiplier value, 0 to disable.

dry_allowed_length.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. DRY allowed length value.

dry_penalty_last_n.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. DRY last n tokens penalized value.

dry_sequence_breakers.description: An array of string sequence breakers for DRY.

xtc_probability.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. XTC probability. Set to above 0 to enable XTC.

nsigma.description: KoboldCpp ONLY. Top N-Sigma value. Set to above 0 to enable nsigma.

logprobs.description: If true, return up to 10 top logprobs for generated tokens. Incurs performance overhead.

replace_instruct_placeholders.description: If true, replaces instruct placeholders {{[INPUT]}} and {{[OUTPUT]}} with backend selected instruct tags.

last_draft_success.description: Last generation draft successes in tokens.

last_draft_failed.description: Last generation draft failures in tokens.

total_img_gens.description: Total image requests generated since startup.

total_tts_gens.description: Total tts requests generated since startup.

total_transcribe_gens.description: Total transcribe requests generated since startup.

stop_reason.description: Reason the generation stopped. INVALID=-1, OUT_OF_TOKENS=0, EOS_TOKEN_HIT=1, CUSTOM_STOPPER=2

idle.description: Status of backend, busy or idle.

hordeexitcounter.description: Status of embedded horde worker, if applicable. If it's too high, may have crashed.

uptime.description: Seconds that the server has been running for.

idletime.description: Seconds that the server has been inactive for.

quiet.description: Is the server in quiet (no logging) mode.

last_input_count.description: Number of input tokens in the last request.

parameters.description: JSON Schema describing the function arguments.

OpenAITool.description: Function tool definition. KoboldCpp uses the name, description, and JSON Schema parameters.

OpenAIToolCallDelta.description: A partial streamed tool call. Metadata and argument text may arrive in separate chunks.

oneOf.description: KoboldCpp consumes data:image URLs. Remote image URLs are not downloaded.

content.description: Text, or OpenAI-style text, image_url, and input_audio content parts.

max_completion_tokens.description: Accepted as a fallback when max_tokens is absent.

frequency_penalty.description: Accepted as a fallback alias for presence_penalty.
Accepted as a fallback alias for presence_penalty.

tool_choice.description: Supports auto, required, none, an exact function name, or an OpenAI-style function choice object.

response_format.description: json_object and json_schema are converted to a generation grammar.

reasoning_effort.description: Forwarded to the active Jinja chat template.

OpenAICompletionChunk.description: JSON value carried by each data: line. The stream ends with data: [DONE].

OpenAIChatCompletionChunk.description: JSON value carried by each data: line. Tool calls may be buffered and emitted near the end. The stream ends with data: [DONE].

OpenAIResponsesRequest.description: Experimental subset converted internally to Chat Completions.

max_tokens.description: KoboldCpp compatibility field; max_output_tokens is not currently consumed.

output.description: Assistant message and function_call output items.

OpenAIResponseStreamEvent.description: Data object for one Responses SSE event. KoboldCpp emits response.created, response.output_item.added, response.content_part.added, response.output_text.delta, response.output_text.done, response.output_item.done, and response.completed.

n.description: Accepted, but KoboldCpp returns one image.

language.description: Language code, or auto when omitted.

AnthropicSource.description: Media/document source. Images and audio are usable as model media when supplied as base64; URL image sources are not downloaded. Document text/data is inserted as text.

model.description: Compatibility model identifier. KoboldCpp generates with the active text model and reports that model's name in the response.

stop_sequences.description: Accepted in the payload but not currently mapped to stopping. Use the KoboldCpp/OpenAI-compatible stop field for working stop strings.

tool_choice.description: Supports auto, required, none, an exact function name, or an OpenAI-style function choice object. Anthropic's native {type: tool, name: ...} object is not currently interpreted.

AnthropicStreamEvent.description: Data object for an Anthropic-style SSE event. The SSE event name matches type.

delta.description: text_delta, thinking_delta, input_json_delta, or final stop information.

BearerAuth.description: Required on protected endpoints when KoboldCpp is launched with --password. Send the password as `Authorization: Bearer <password>`. If both passwords are configured, --adminpassword is also accepted as an alternative on these regular protected endpoints.

AdminBearerAuth.description: Used by /api/admin endpoints when --adminpassword is configured. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <adminpassword>`. Admin endpoints also require the relevant admin mode options such as --admin and --admindir. Failed admin authentication currently returns an empty or unsuccessful HTTP 200 response rather than HTTP 401.

post.description:
Generates text given a prompt and generation settings, with Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming.

Unspecified values are set to defaults.

The response uses `text/event-stream`. Each event has `event: message` and a JSON `data` object containing `token` (a generated text fragment) and `finish_reason`. Events are separated by a blank line. Concatenate the `token` values to obtain the generated text.

`finish_reason` is `null` while generation is in progress. The final event has an empty `token` and a `finish_reason` of `stop`, `length`, or `error`. The server then closes the connection; no `[DONE]` sentinel is sent.
